contradictions_found.claim: docs/03-PROGRESS.md 'Current position': '1054 Rust tests (2026-09-05)'; review 2026-09-05 evidence.json: rust passed 1054, failed 0
contradictions_found.cause: false positive: scripts/pre-commit:93 endpoint pattern flags https://www.debian.org in packaging/deb/build.sh:56 (Debian copyright-format URL) as 'a host the Core must not know'; debian.org is absent from the exclusion list at scripts/pre-commit:94
contradictions_found.risk: scripts/pre-commit's own error text invites 'commit with --no-verify', which would disable the public-repo hygiene protection entirely
contradictions_found.fix: add debian\.org to the exclusion at scripts/pre-commit:94, or invert the rule so a URL is an endpoint only when it appears in a peer=/endpoint= assignment

contradictions_found.claim: docs/03-PROGRESS.md: '60 vitest'; review 2026-09-05 evidence.json: vitest_ui passed 60, failed 0
contradictions_found.measured: npm test -> 28 failed, 28 passed (56 collected, 7 files); NODE_ENV=test npx vitest run -> 60 passed, 60 (7 files)
contradictions_found.cause: environmental: this shell exports NODE_ENV=production, so Vite resolves the React production build and React Testing Library's act() is stripped from it. Error text: 'act(...) is not supported in production builds of React.'
contradictions_found.fix: set process.env.NODE_ENV = 'test' in ui/vite.config.ts, or "test": "NODE_ENV=test vitest run" in ui/package.json
contradictions_found.note: ui/vite.config.ts:45 configures the vitest block and sets nothing; ui/package.json defines test as bare 'vitest run'

contradictions_found.claim: docs/01-BUILD-PROMPT.md:93 'These are CI gates'; CLAUDE.md rule 3 'Latency budgets are the specification ... are CI gates, not aspirations'
contradictions_found.measured: no .github/, no .gitlab-ci.yml, no pipeline configuration of any kind in the repository
contradictions_found.consequence: cargo test, npm test, the Playwright suites and bench-latency run only when a human or agent remembers; this is the root cause of C1 remaining invisible across at least one commit
contradictions_found.partial_mitigation: crates/cortex-sync/tests/hygiene.rs:6 runs the pre-commit script from cargo test so the hygiene gate travels with the suite; this does not cover the latency budgets, which no test asserts
contradictions_found.fix: one workflow file: cargo test --workspace, cargo clippy -- -D warnings, cargo fmt --check, NODE_ENV=test npm test, Playwright, and a workflow_dispatch or self-hosted job for bench-latency on an idle machine
